title: Industry Nine Hush 32er Wheel Platform
content:
Developed alongside the builders and manufacturers pushing mountain bike design forward, the Hush is Industry Nine‘s foray into 32er wheels and its latest exploration into rim prototyping, wheel design, and the possibilities of new standards…

Rather than adapting an existing rim to fit a new wheel size, Industry Nine’s WR1 carbon team engineered the Hush from the ground up, using finite element analysis to understand how the larger diameter could be tuned around the stiffness and compliance riders have come to expect from a modern 29″ wheel.

The result is a wheel that carries the familiar impact strength and radial compliance of the proven 29″ wheel, with minimal reduction in lateral stiffness expected from moving to a larger diameter. At the same time, 32″ brings its own advantages: increased momentum, a shallower approach angle, and improved rollover through rough terrain.

The Hush pairs a 24-hole 2:1 spoke pattern to Industry Nine’s SOLiX hub and the proven strength of Industry Nine’s one-piece System spokes. The final configuration came only after testing different spoke counts, J-bend vs System spokes and hub spacings to understand how the complete wheel system performed as a whole.

WR1, Industry Nine’s in-house carbon and rim design house, hand-lays every Hush rim in Kamloops, British Columbia.

The project began before there was a defined consumer category for 32″ wheels. Industry Nine began working alongside framebuilders and OEM partners developing some of the first 32″ mountain bike platforms, giving the team an opportunity to explore the challenges of the new format alongside the people building the bikes around it.

Hush isn’t Industry Nine’s declaration that 32″ is the future of mountain biking. It’s a contribution to finding out, as pushing into something new has always been part of how mountain biking moves forward.

Hush is available now as a complete wheelset for 32er Trail and XC mountain bikes at industrynine.com.
